tools.name: sarbacane_get_credits
tools.description: The account's remaining credits per type (email campaigns, SMS, eye tracking, Sendkit emails) with expiry date and subscription type. GET /v1/credits.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_users
tools.description: Users and pending invitations of the Sarbacane account (name, email, role, team). GET /v1/users.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_lists
tools.description: All contact lists of the account, with their ids. Use the ids for contacts, fields and campaigns. GET /v1/lists.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_list_fields
tools.description: The custom fields (columns) of a contact list: id, caption and type (STRING, BOOL, INT, DATE). Field ids are the keys used when writing contacts. GET /v1/lists/{listId}/fields.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_contacts
tools.description: Contacts of one list (personal data: email, phone, custom fields). Filter by email, phone, a text search across fields, or the modification date. GET /v1/lists/{listId}/contacts.

tools.name: sarbacane_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to a contact list. Give an email, a phone number or both, and optional custom field values. Adds a new record; use sarbacane_upsert_contact to update an existing contact. POST /v1/lists/{listId}/contacts.

tools.name: sarbacane_upsert_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to a list, or update it when the same email/phone pair already exists (custom field values are overwritten). POST /v1/lists/{listId}/contacts/upsert.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_blacklists
tools.description: All blacklists (suppression lists) of the account, with their ids. GET /v1/blacklists.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_blacklist_entries
tools.description: Entries of a blacklist by kind: bounces (invalid addresses), unsubscribers or complaints (personal data: email, phone). Filter by email, phone or modification date. GET /v1/blacklists/{blacklistId}/{bounces|unsubscribers|complaints}.

tools.name: sarbacane_add_unsubscriber
tools.description: WRITE: record an email and/or phone as unsubscribed in a blacklist, so campaigns using that blacklist skip it. Cannot be undone with these tools. POST /v1/blacklists/{blacklistId}/unsubscribers.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_campaigns
tools.description: Campaigns of the account (id, name, kind, created/edited, recipient count). Filter by state or a text in the name or subject. GET /v1/campaigns.

tools.name: sarbacane_get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign: state, kind, blacklists, send ids, sent date. The send id is needed to see content. GET /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}.

tools.name: sarbacane_get_campaign_report
tools.description: Statistics of a campaign per send: delivered count, opens, openers, clicks, clickers, unsubscribers, devices and operating systems. GET /v1/reports/{campaignId}.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_campaign_recipients
tools.description: Recipients attached to a campaign (personal data: email, phone). GET /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}/recipients.

tools.name: sarbacane_list_webhooks
tools.description: Webhook subscriptions of the account: url, display name and subscribed event kinds. GET /v1/webhooks.

tools.name: sarbacane_create_email_campaign
tools.description: WRITE: create a new email campaign as a DRAFT. It is never sent by these tools: add content (sarbacane_set_campaign_content or sarbacane_import_campaign_template) and a contact list (sarbacane_set_campaign_list), then send it from Sarbacane. POST /v1/campaigns/email.

tools.name: sarbacane_set_campaign_content
tools.description: WRITE: set the HTML (and optional plain-text) content of an email campaign's send, replacing what was there. Without send_id the campaign's only send is used (an A/B test campaign has several: pass one). POST /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}/send/{sendId}/content.

tools.name: sarbacane_import_campaign_template
tools.description: WRITE: load a saved template's content into an email campaign, replacing its content. POST /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}/content.

tools.name: sarbacane_set_campaign_list
tools.description: WRITE: import a contact list's contacts as the recipients of a campaign. It does not send the campaign. POST /v1/campaigns/{campaignId}/list.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sarbacane_get_credits, sarbacane_list_users, sarbacane_list_contacts, sarbacane_create_contact, sarbacane_upsert_contact, sarbacane_list_blacklist_entries, sarbacane_list_campaign_recipients, sarbacane_list_webhooks, sarbacane_create_email_campaign, sarbacane_import_campaign_template, sarbacane_set_campaign_list · Private data: sarbacane_list_lists, sarbacane_list_list_fields, sarbacane_list_contacts, sarbacane_create_contact, sarbacane_upsert_contact, sarbacane_add_unsubscriber, sarbacane_create_email_campaign, sarbacane_set_campaign_list · Public sink: sarbacane_get_credits, sarbacane_list_users, sarbacane_list_contacts, sarbacane_create_contact, sarbacane_upsert_contact, sarbacane_list_blacklist_entries, sarbacane_add_unsubscriber, sarbacane_get_campaign, sarbacane_get_campaign_report, sarbacane_list_campaign_recipients, sarbacane_list_webhooks, sarbacane_create_email_campaign, sarbacane_set_campaign_content, sarbacane_import_campaign_template, sarbacane_set_campaign_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sarbacane_get_credits, sarbacane_list_users, sarbacane_list_contacts, sarbacane_create_contact, sarbacane_upsert_contact, sarbacane_list_blacklist_entries, sarbacane_list_campaign_recipients, sarbacane_list_webhooks, sarbacane_create_email_campaign, sarbacane_import_campaign_template, sarbacane_set_campaign_list · Private data: sarbacane_list_lists, sarbacane_list_list_fields, sarbacane_list_contacts, sarbacane_create_contact, sarbacane_upsert_contact, sarbacane_add_unsubscriber, sarbacane_create_email_campaign, sarbacane_set_campaign_list · Public sink: sarbacane_get_credits, sarbacane_list_users, sarbacane_list_contacts, sarbacane_create_contact, sarbacane_upsert_contact, sarbacane_list_blacklist_entries, sarbacane_add_unsubscriber, sarbacane_get_campaign, sarbacane_get_campaign_report, sarbacane_list_campaign_recipients, sarbacane_list_webhooks, sarbacane_create_email_campaign, sarbacane_set_campaign_content, sarbacane_import_campaign_template, sarbacane_set_campaign_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
